title: Comparison of methylmercury production and accumulation in sediments of the Congaree and Edisto River basins, South Carolina, 2004-06
citation: Bradley, P.M., Chapelle, F.H., and Journey, C.A., 2009, Comparison of methylmercury production and accumulation in sediments of the Congaree and Edisto River basins, South Carolina, 2004-06: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report SIR-2009-5021, map scale 1:909,000.
notes: Mercury geochemistry report (9 p.); the PDF is the record's own report. No geologic units, borings or structures are described. Recorded: sediment sampling sites (kind other, locations only as stated in the text; Figure 1 map labels are garbled), statements about ground-water seepage, and South Carolina references. Body text is two-column and interleaved in the text layer, so quotes are kept within one column line. Skipped general (non-South Carolina) references on mercury chemistry and methods. Sediment Hg/MeHg values are shown only in figures 2-4 (bar charts without readable numbers) and were not recorded.
